ListingVenue.description: A reviewed listing venue: one exchange, a group of exchanges or the over-the-counter market.
ListingVenue.title: ListingVenue

ListingVenuePart.description:
A listing venue: the provider's own wording and the reviewed code it maps to.

The code is null when no reviewed table lists the provider's wording; the wording is always served.
ListingVenuePart.title: ListingVenuePart

description:
One ticker's instrument profile: its identity, its kind and the currency its price is quoted in.

``schema_version`` is this document's own lineage and is independent of every other document's.

instrument_identifier.description: The data provider's own identifier of the instrument; null when it gave none.
instrument_identifier.title: Instrument Identifier

instrument_name.description: The instrument's name; null when no provider gave one.
instrument_name.title: Instrument Name

issuer_identifier.description: The identifier of the issuer, such as an SEC central index key; null when unknown.
issuer_identifier.title: Issuer Identifier

kind.description: The kind of instrument, from the reviewed list; null when the provider's value is not on it.

listing_venue.description: The exchange or venue the instrument is listed on, as the data provider reports it, with the reviewed code it maps to; null when the provider gave none.

provider_id.description: The data provider that gave the identity; /v1/info lists the providers with their names.
provider_id.title: Provider Id

quote_currency.description: The currency the listing's price is quoted in, as the provider reports it, such as USD; null when the provider reported none.
quote_currency.title: Quote Currency

refreshed_at.description: When the profile was last checked with a data provider, as an ISO 8601 instant with its offset. A profile that has not been checked within the configured freshness window is still served.
refreshed_at.title: Refreshed At

ticker.description: The ticker the profile describes, trimmed and upper-cased.
ticker.title: Ticker

title: InstrumentProfileDocument
